message.content:
Based on my search, I can help clarify what you're asking about. **PFG** stands for **"Performance Fishing Gear"** — it's a trademarked line by **Columbia Sportswear**, not a generic clothing term.

When people refer to **"thin PFG shirts,"** they're typically describing the **lightweight, breathable styles** within Columbia's PFG line. These thin PFG shirts are commonly called:

## Common Names for Thin PFG-Style Shirts:

| Term | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **PFG Tamiami** | Columbia's most popular thin button-down fishing shirt |
| **Terminal Tackle** | Another lightweight PFG shirt style (long-sleeve crew neck) |
| **Sun Shirt / Sun Protection Shirt** | Generic term for thin, UPF-rated fishing shirts |
| **Dri-Fit / Microfiber Shirt** | Generic terms for the thin synthetic material |
| **Performance Fishing Shirt** | Broader category name |

## Key Characteristics of These Thin Shirts:

- **Material**: High-tech **polyester** or **nylon** (very thin, lightweight fabric)
- **Weight**: Extremely lightweight and breathable
- **Features**: Moisture-wicking (Omni-Wick™), UPF sun protection (Omni-Shade™ UPF 40-50), mesh vents
- **Design**: Often long-sleeved for sun protection but very thin to stay cool

The **Columbia PFG Tamiami II** is the most iconic "thin PFG shirt" — it's a button-down specifically designed to be incredibly thin and cool for hot, humid fishing conditions while still providing sun protection.

If you're looking for generic/non-brand versions, search for terms like **"performance fishing shirt,"** **"sun shirt,"** or **"UV protection fishing shirt"** — these will have the same thin, lightweight, quick-drying properties as Columbia's PFG line.

Sources:
1. https://www.leelinesports.com/what-are-the-best-fishing-clothing-brands/
2. https://bikehike.org/what-does-pfg-mean-on-columbia-shirts/
3. https://thehikingadventure.com/best-womens-hiking-shirts-for-hot-weather
4. https://bikehike.org/what-is-a-pfg-shirt/
5. https://www.fishing.news/news/43120/columbia-pfg-t-shirt-specially-designed-for-anglers
6. https://www.academy.com/p/columbia-sportswear-boys-pfg-super-terminal-tackle-long-sleeve-t-shirt?sku=ocean-blue-deep-large
